18d7f80a9a6801b266b04030ba4247deb38e3694.RewardText: This head will be posted at the gates of Garadar for all to see. The ogres will think twice before interrupting sacred Mag'hari rituals.

18d8ce2f9b5000e7f62aca169c15bc300698f407.LogDescription: Enter The Forge of Souls from the side of Icecrown Citadel and find Lady Jaina Proudmoore.
18d8ce2f9b5000e7f62aca169c15bc300698f407.QuestDescription: $C! Come close quickly, I must have a word!$B$BMy patron, the Lady Jaina Proudmoore, has uncovered a hole in the defenses of Icecrown Citadel into a place she referred to as "The Forge of Souls." She sent word before she left for me to find any help that I could... and, well, I was hoping that might be you.$B$BPlease, find her there as soon as you can.

18d9f87c2aed806dc0cd7c77872350f65ebe04e8.LogDescription: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.
18d9f87c2aed806dc0cd7c77872350f65ebe04e8.QuestDescription: See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in Azshara recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.$B$BAfter fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.$B$BI'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.

It will not be easy, for they are held by the Smolderthorn trolls within Blackrock Spire.  The spire is a dark mountain of fire between the Burning Steppes and the Searing Gorge.$B$BGood luck, $N.  Blackrock Spire is no place for decent folk...
